description: This Java class models a key mapping element within the OFBiz entity framework, providing constructors, accessors, and utility methods for key map objects.

classes.name: ModelKeyMap
classes.description: Immutable class representing a key map with methods for XML serialization, comparison, and equality.

methods.name: ModelKeyMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing from field names, with relFieldName defaulting to fieldName if null.

methods.name: ModelKeyMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing from an XML Element, extracting attributes for field names.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field in the entity.

methods.name: getRelFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the related entity's field.

methods.name: makeKeyMapList
methods.description: Factory methods creating lists of ModelKeyMap objects with varying numbers of key pairs.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on fullName.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the object to an XML Element.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two ModelKeyMap objects based on fullName.
